description: This file contains utility functions, includes, and declarations related to MKLDNN (oneDNN) integration within the ATen library of PyTorch, including tensor operations, device checks, and fusion attribute mappings.

methods.name: mkldnn_layer_norm_last_index_weight_bias_f32
methods.description: Performs layer normalization with last index, returning weight, bias, and normalized tensors.

methods.name: pool_output_sizes
methods.description: Calculates output sizes for pooling operations based on input parameters.

methods.name: check_mkldnn_binary_fusion_inputs
methods.description: Checks validity of inputs for MKLDNN binary fusion operations.

methods.name: padding_r
methods.description: Calculates right padding for ConvTranspose based on padding and output padding.

methods.name: may_convert_to_default_contiguous_strides
methods.description: Converts tensor to default contiguous strides for performance optimization.

methods.name: mkldnn_bf16_device_check_arm
methods.description: Checks if ARM device supports BF16 for MKLDNN.

methods.name: mkldnn_fp16_device_check_arm
methods.description: Checks if ARM device supports FP16 for MKLDNN.

methods.name: is_arm_neoverse
methods.description: Checks if the CPU architecture is ARM Neoverse.

methods.name: mkldnn_bf16_device_check
methods.description: Checks if the device supports BF16 for MKLDNN, considering architecture.

methods.name: mkldnn_fp16_device_check
methods.description: Checks if the device supports FP16 for MKLDNN, considering architecture.

methods.name: mkldnn_check_low_precision
methods.description: Verifies if the device supports low precision (BF16 or FP16) operations.
